audit_standard: IFRS / PSAK Forensic Audit & ISO 31000 ERM Framework

findings.description: Balance sheet equation broken! Assets ($8,500,000.00) != Liabilities + Equity ($8,050,000.00). Unreconciled gap: $450,000.00.
findings.root_cause: Omission of $450,000 accrued restructuring and warranty liability from current liabilities.
findings.corrective_action: Increase Total Liabilities by $450,000.00 to balance equation: $4,650,000 + $3,850,000 = $8,500,000.

findings.description: EBITDA overstated! Submitter claimed $1,150,000.00, but true operating EBITDA is $800,000.00. Discrepancy: $350,000.00.
findings.root_cause: Improper inclusion of $350,000 one-off non-operating asset sale gain into recurring operational earnings.
findings.corrective_action: Strip out non-operating gain from EBITDA. Restate true operating EBITDA as $800,000.00.

findings.description: Monthly burn rate understated. Claimed: $100,000.00/mo, True Burn: $150,000.00/mo. True runway is 12.0 months (not 18.0 months).
findings.root_cause: Omission of mandatory quarterly tax accruals and outstanding vendor payment schedules.
findings.corrective_action: Restate runway to 12.0 months. Recommend establishing a $300,000 liquidity buffer immediately.

findings.description: Zero compliance reserve allocated for UU PDP No. 27/2022 and SPBE security mandates.
findings.root_cause: Management failed to budget for mandatory data protection audits and incident contingency.
findings.corrective_action: Mandate immediate provisioning of $120,000 Statutory Compliance Reserve under Section 67 UU PDP.
findings.statutory_risk: Fines of up to 2% of annual turnover under Article 57 UU PDP if unaddressed.

erm_risk_matrix.risk: Statutory Fines under UU PDP No. 27/2022
